incidents.name: Discover ETHpledge spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The ETHpledge contract's pledgein() valued the deposited DISCOVER against the PancakeSwap pair spot reserves, so a flash loan moved that price and let the attacker pledge cheap tokens for an inflated USDT credit.

sources.ref: onchain review: ETHpledge 0xe732a7bD6706CBD6834B300D7c56a8D2096723A7 created 2022-05-30T05:35:56Z by 0xd2c84e295a3b54861bc32b76a0e567dba608b092, unrelated to attack sender 0x446247bb10b77d1bca4d4a396e014526d1aba277; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 16,276.81 USDT left the DISCOVER pool and 45.97 WBNB was routed out in the exploit transaction. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the spot price it read. Loss converted: 49 BNB x $309.74 at incidentTimestamp 1654501821 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $15,177.
